exposure: Infant care setting (Newborn Nursery, NICU, NICU/KMC Ward)
Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) after NICU stay
cohort: Newly delivered mothers at University Teaching Hospitals in Lusaka, Zambia, whose infants were discharged from the Newborn Nursery, NICU, or NICU/KMC Ward.
finding: Admission to the Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) ward following NICU was not associated with a lower prevalence of maternal postpartum depression compared to direct NICU discharge, although PPD positivity rates were significantly higher in both NICU and KMC arms compared to the Newborn Nursery arm.
